evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Frames operational safety and capability as dependent upon verified practice, appealing to security/stability (conservation) and verified craft execution (competence).

mints.name: PracticeAsCapabilityReality
mints.title: a capability not rehearsed is not actually held
mints.frame: Does the expression define true operational readiness or possession strictly by its demonstrated, rehearsed execution?
